book.name: Matyu
book.title: Matyu Matyhuho Fatmata ogepma irim togoc

content: Herötho yun bödeuna Jönthon bangaro magung
Oro, bongono wocin Gavmanthon morömo King Heröt yu Yesu youp orongi tongidocma worochon fatno kombigoc.
Tongo yu youp amnani ingoroc inogoc, “Amna woi Jön, yamuc gung imocimoc amna woroc. Yu kumkumonma wekongga gesö orongi sogitmuna youp inobarac ihorocno tongitac.”

Oro osuc wömai Herötho orugo Filip yuhon oweno usem tongo inoha tongsigoc. Tuna Jön yamuc gung imocimoc amna yu Heröt ‘muno’ inongga yogoc, “Nongoru mata noniho wömai gocho toroc kiap wo tarocmaha ‘muno’ yac.” Jöntho ihoroc inogocmaha tongga Heröt yu wot omom toctocha kombigoc mahong yu suraroha botogoc. Owi amna ambaracho wömai Jöntha kombigung, yui Kopotorochon yong tuctuc amna moröma au. Worocha tongga Heröt yu tawa amna inong muuna yu ongga Jön sogito sendec akep tongo yi bucin tohong yugung.

Oro, bongono auho wömai King Herötho ‘nochon öngkup öngkup bongonoha kombina’ yongo tong sonoc moröma togoc. Tuna owi moröma au mano Herödias yuhon wenoho engmuna amna nacno nagungmahon yangamin tong kumec au togoc. Tuna Herötho owi berac wo angibip toup sinom togoc.
Worocha tongga yu yong koing mata ingoroc inogoc, “Goc gakain ibiba tanda yansawoha kombingga nania nocho boinno sinom yapmu woroc gamontat.”

Ihoroc inuna owi berachon macno Herödias, yu kombic kombic au weno imuna yu ongga Heröt ingoroc inogoc, “Noc wömai ingoroc kombihat: Jön yamuc gung imocimoc amna yuhon bigo mangga wagadec singga teng nam.”
Ihoroc inuna King Heröt yu mata woroc kombingga soroc yogoc mahong ino amna koböcho yangamin mata yong koing yogocmaha tongga yu ‘yangam fap tityit’ yongo ‘öc’ yogoc.
Tongo yuho tawa amna au inuna yu yi bucin ongmuna Jön bangaro magoc.
Mangga waga audec singga tengga owi berac wo imogoc. Tuna yu wo sogitmuna macno ot tonggoc.
Oro mit wömai Jönthon youp wabkaracniho engmuya Jönthon godip föbogon tongga oring sigung. Oring singga ongmuya King Herötho togocma worochon fatno Yesu inogung.
Yesuho amna 5,000 ihoroc nacno silip tong imogoc

Oro Yesu yu Jön wodungmahon fatno wo kombingga inohogon girang sogida böcsa woroc imun fauna sa au amna maiyan woce onggoc. Tuna owi amna yu Yesu woce ongeyacno wo kombingga böcsano dongyu fauya Yesu guroc uyap tan tonggung.
Ihoroc tuya Yesu yu girang imun fauna terodec öngo yagocmai owi amna koböcma sinom woce itmuya yuha torengga idung. Idiya Yesuho yangga yuha uroc imuna obukocnima youn orokogung.

Ihoroc tongo idina sa urop dobocsisicha tuna youp amnaniho yuot engmuya inogung, “Sa ngocinu amna maididang o sep urop ohoc ohocha tac. Worocha goc owi amna ngo yoi fauya ongmuya böcsa woce woce nacno wöarut.”
Ihoroc inuya Yesuho inogoc, “Muno, yu mangoning, sonibut nacno imarut.”
Ihoroc yuna youp amnani yogung, “Nonu nacno sowarango obukema orin söng yaihogon itnimang.”
Yuya Yesuho yogoc, “Nacno sowarango orin söng wo noc namarut.”

Tongo Yesuho ‘owi amna owendec omoc idarut’ yongo inogoc. Tongo nacno sowarango obukema orin söng yai wo fogito momdec foringmun uuna Kopotoroc ecec inongga nacno sowarango wo uboda youp amnani imogoc. Tuna yuho silip tongo owi amna imogung.
Imuya owi amna ambarac yu nacno wo nangga modibo foc tuna nacno nong docno ambaracno wo youp amnaniho feng suran tongo dumbu 12 ihoroc oheuya foc togung.
Nacno nagungma woi amna 5,000 ihorocho nagung. Owi wabkarac wömai maembadung.
Yesu yu yamuc öngkoringdec sansantho onggoc
Oro, Yesu yu wohogon ‘youp amnanai osuc fat namarut’ yongo inong muuna yu girang sogida forosingga yamuc öngköring aramo öke onggonga togung. Onguya Yesuho owi amna inong muuna uyap onggung.
Ongbödeuya yu inogon dönac yocyocha sa urongo audec ögoc. Tuna sep urop ohogoc.
Sa urongo idina youp amnani yu girangdec yamuc bonip idiya sumpho girang tamarodec busuna yamuc funfuroho öngga girang wagang fodigoc.
Tuna isoc isocanneu Yesu yamuc öngkoringdec sansantho ongga yuot eboc.
Ehuna youp amnani yu angmuya toup botongga kudat konoc konoc tongo mamboda yogung, “Ayöö, dogu au epac yo.”
Yuya Yesu yu karupgon inogoc, “Son koing songga idarut. Naka epat, son botoninga!”
Ihoroc inuna Pitaho inogoc, “Moröma, gaka eparocanu goc naniya nocho yamucdec sansantho gocot ongowa.”
Yuna Yesuho yogoc, “Epi!” Ihoroc yuna Pita yu girang imun fauna forosingga yamucdec sansantho Yesuot onggoc.
Woce ongmuna agocmai sumpho orongi sinom busongga idoc. Tuna Pitaho wo angbotongga yamuc ganang ohonggonga togoc. Ohongmuna mambodoc, “Moröma, tongfat nehi!”
Ihoroc yuna Yesuho karupgon oburo imonda Pita sogitmuna inogoc, “Kombing tobic tobica obmugon. Goc yaha irot yai taroc?”
Ihoroc tongga girangdec bangyun öngunya wohogon sumpho bödegoc.
Tuna amna girangdec idungma yu Yesu yong moröng imongga yogung, “Boinno sinom, goc Kopotorochon Manano.”
Yesuho Genesaret böcsa itmuna owi amna obukocnima youn orokogung
Oro, Yesuot youp amnaniot yu yamuc öngköring kondong tongga Genesaret böcsa woce ongkubung.
Woce ongkuya böc morömpho Yesu angga karupgon mata siuya böcsa ambehecgon idungma woce onguna owi amna mata wo kombingga nucni obukocnima yangada Yesuot febung.

Fengmuya Yesu dönac orongi ingoroc inogung, “Goc owi amna obukocnima ngo yang banaya yu tec tohomamucnodec oburoho got möngga orokodarut.” Ihoroc inuya owi amna obukocniho Yesuhon tec tohomunmucno wot mungga ambarac orokogung.
